yield-accumulator.description: Consolidates yield strategy rewards from multiple stablecoins into a single reward token for simplified Phlimbo distribution. Part of the Phoenix/Behodler ecosystem.
yield-accumulator.notes: External claimers swap their reward token holdings for pending yield strategy rewards at a discount, enabling decentralized conversion without protocol oracles/AMMs.

phlimbo-linear.description: PhlimboEA - Staking yield farm for phUSD tokens with Linear Depletion reward distribution
phlimbo-linear.notes: Part of the Phoenix/Behodler ecosystem. Main contract receives rewards from yield-accumulator and distributes them to stakers.

Dual reward system: phUSD (minted based on APY) + stable tokens (from yield accumulator)

phoenix-vault.scopeUpdateReason: Story-037 removed SurplusTracker/SurplusWithdrawer. Story-038/039 added ERC4626Market strategy + CurveAMMAdapter. Scope refocused on the new additions per user request.
phoenix-vault.description: NEW: ERC4626MarketYieldStrategy + CurveAMMAdapter. The market strategy buys/sells ERC4626 vault tokens via AMM (instead of direct vault.deposit/withdraw) to handle vaults with restrictions (e.g., sUSDe cooldown). CurveAMMAdapter implements the IAMMAdapter interface against Curve Router NG and enforces bidirectional route configuration. AMMRoutes.json supplies pre-computed deployment routes (currently USDe<->sUSDe).
phoenix-vault.notes: Part of the Phoenix/Behodler ecosystem. Base class AYieldStrategy (442 LOC, previously audited) provides pause, reentrancy, two-phase total withdrawal, client/withdrawer auth. Scope focuses on new additions and how they integrate. SurplusTracker/SurplusWithdrawer were removed in Story-037 and are no longer in scope.
designDecisions: Market-based ERC4626 interaction via AMM swap rather than direct vault deposit/withdraw
Principal is decremented by REQUESTED amount on withdraw, not RECEIVED amount (any shortfall accrues to protocol)
Bidirectional route invariant: CurveAMMAdapter requires both A->B and B->A routes configured before either swap works
Slippage tolerance configured in basis points, applied to expected output at swap time
Two-phase emergency withdrawal (totalWithdrawal) with 24h waiting period and 48h execution window inherited from AYieldStrategy
systemAssumptions: Deployment scripts correctly populate CurveAMMAdapter routes from AMMRoutes.json
Curve Router NG at 0x16C6521Dff6baB339122a0FE25a9116693265353 is trusted
ERC4626 vault share price is monotonically non-decreasing (or at least that losses are acceptable to clients)
Underlying tokens are standard ERC20 without transfer hooks or fee-on-transfer
Vault owner acts in best interest of protocol and clients

nft-staking.scopeUpdateReason: Added src/BatchNFTMinter.sol per user request. The new batch minter feature (story-009) is the focus of this audit run. INFTSupply.sol remains a context dependency interface and is not in scope.
nft-staking.knownIssuesSource: lib/phoenix-nft-staking/CLAUDE.md (rewritten in story-008, commit 3087b8e). No dedicated Known Issues / Out of Scope / Limitations section exists; design decisions and invariants below were extracted from the Feature Specification and Critical Invariants sections.
knownIssues: Owner trust assumptions: owner controls setTargetAPY (bounded by MAX_TARGET_APY = 0.5e18), setDispatcherIndex, setNFTMinter, setDispatcherHook, setStakedId, topUp, pullAndRefresh - centralization is by design
Pauser trust assumptions: a designated pauser address (via global Pauser/IPausable) can pause/unpause user-facing state-changing functions

setStakedId / setDispatcherIndex / setNFTMinter only callable while totalStaked == 0 - this is intentional to prevent mid-stake reconfiguration from swinging APY math; do NOT flag the empty-pool guard as a DoS
setDispatcherHook has NO empty-pool guard - hook rotation is intentionally a live operation

emergencyWithdraw forfeits pending reward, skips _syncBudget/_updatePool, and is callable while paused - by design as escape hatch for ID-change migrations or broken dispatcher hook / NFT minter / recompute path
topUp does NOT call _syncBudget - intentional to preserve dispatcher-hook-independence
Floor rounding via OZ Math.mulDiv used throughout reward math - conservative-for-protocol is intentional
Edge cases totalStaked == 0 || targetAPY == 0 || price == 0 collapse rewardRate R to 0 - by design (zero-APY is a supported pause-emissions mode)

APY-as-floor semantics: per-NFT effective APY for the most-recent minter equals targetAPY exactly; earlier minters who paid latestPrice / r^k earn targetAPY * r^k > targetAPY (geometric-growth multiple). Lone staker earns targetAPY (or geometric multiple), NOT N * targetAPY - there is no participation multiplier. This was the audit M-03 fix (sizing R against the staked subset S = totalStaked * latestPrice rather than aggregate minted notional T)
Late stakers never get retroactive rewards - accRewardPerShare advances only between lastRewardTime and block.timestamp

Emissions stop cleanly at windowEnd; recompute pushing windowEnd forward after depletion is not retroactive (prior accrual settled first via _updatePool capping elapsed at min(now, windowEnd) - lastRewardTime)

ScheduleRecomputed event: on-chain field name totalNFTValue is preserved for off-chain consumer compatibility but its meaning shifted in audit M-03 from aggregate T to staked-subset S = totalStaked * latestPrice - do NOT flag as misleading naming

Single active token ID per staker contract (one staker per NFT at a time) - cross-ID leakage is structurally impossible by design; no in-contract whitelist, no per-ID mapping, no allocation-point math

_safePay reverts on shortfall rather than silently capping payouts; wei-level dust escape into rewardBudget when per-user pending floor-rounding marginally exceeds cumulative _updatePool increments is intentional
designDecisions: Variable-runway / owner-set APY target emission model: owner sets target APY, contract derives R = S * A / SECONDS_PER_YEAR, runway V/R is a derived quantity
S = totalStaked * latestPrice (staked-subset notional), not aggregate minted notional T - audit M-03 fix

latestPrice = price / r where r = 1 + growthBasisPoints/10_000; price from nftMinter.configs(dispatcherIndex) is the NEXT mint price, dividing by r recovers the most-recent paid price; growthBasisPoints == 0 collapses latestPrice to price
Pull-on-interaction: every stake/unstake/claim first calls _syncBudget which invokes pull() on the configured dispatcher hook to sweep outstanding mint debt
V = balance + mintDebt (balance plus pending phUSD at the dispatcher hook)
Solvency invariant: balance == rewardBudget + committedDebt holds at ALL times

stake/unstake invoke _recomputeSchedule AFTER totalStaked mutation (in addition to head-of-function _syncBudget recompute at OLD totalStaked); claim does NOT need tail recompute since totalStaked unchanged
setTargetAPY settles accrual at OLD rate via _updatePool() before mutating targetAPY
MAX_TARGET_APY = 0.5e18 (50% APY ceiling)
Share unit = NFT units staked (ERC1155 balances), NOT ERC20 wei

Single-ID ERC1155 staking; ERC1155 contract address is immutable constructor arg; token ID is owner-settable via setStakedId only while totalStaked == 0 (accommodates NFTMinter reconfiguration like Balancer pool migration)
All reward math uses OZ Math.mulDiv with floor rounding (conservative for reward contract)
systemAssumptions: yield-claim-nft sibling submodule's BalancerPoolerMintDebtHook is the source of mint-debt - this staker must be set as the hook's recipient
nftMinter.configs(dispatcherIndex) returns a struct with .price (next mint price) and .growthBasisPoints fields
phUSD is the single reward token; minted by the dispatcher hook on pull()
Global Pauser (from pauser submodule) is the only address allowed to pause/unpause via IPausable
Mutable siblings (lib/mutable/) expose interfaces only - never reach into implementations
OpenZeppelin used for all standard primitives (Ownable, Pausable, ReentrancyGuard, ERC1155 receiver, SafeERC20) - custom reimplementations prohibited
